definitions.gloss: Japan and the United States, Japan-US, Japanese-American (bilateral)
definitions.explanation: An abbreviation combining 日 (Japan) and 米 (America/US), used as a prefix or noun to refer to the bilateral relationship, agreements, or interactions between Japan and the United States.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}{関係|かんけい}は{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
{日米|にちべい}{首脳|しゅのう}{会談|かいだん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A Japan-US summit meeting was held.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}{安全保障条約|あんぜんほしょうじょうやく}は{両国|りょうこく}の{同盟|どうめい}の{基盤|きばん}となっている。
examples.english: The Japan-US Security Treaty forms the foundation of the alliance between both countries.

notes:
USAGE:
{日米|にちべい} is a compound abbreviation using the first characters of {日本|にほん} (Japan) and {米国|べいこく} (the United States). It functions as a prefix modifying nouns related to bilateral topics.

Similar country-pair abbreviations are common in Japanese:
- {日中|にっちゅう}: Japan-China
- {日韓|にっかん}: Japan-South Korea
- {日英|にちえい}: Japan-UK
- {日露|にちろ}: Japan-Russia

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日米|にちべい}{関係|かんけい}: Japan-US relations
- {日米|にちべい}{同盟|どうめい}: Japan-US alliance
- {日米|にちべい}{首脳|しゅのう}{会談|かいだん}: Japan-US summit
- {日米|にちべい}{貿易|ぼうえき}: Japan-US trade
- {日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}: Japan-US security (treaty)
